The [[Naga Shaman Polymock Piece]] is one of the 18 pieces that a player can pick while playing [[Polymock]].

When using this piece, you take the [[Naga Shaman Form]].

[[Category:Polymock pieces]]

==Acquisition==
This piece drops as a reward from [[Havok's Chest]], the [[Mountain Heart Chest]], and the [[Bogroot Chest]].
